size_basis: reactor-class study minimum; jacketed kettle at the 0.25 kg/d monomer duty, reclaim loop to F_RECOVER (node envelope basis, A-M-289)
solids_note: the skid chain (plinth, stand, kettle, jacket envelope, agitator, drive envelope, drain and vent) fuses to one solid; the face-stub connections stay separate until the connecting lines make their joints

kettle.wall_basis: study fab-page value (6 mm); the node books no thickness (WORK_ORDER W12)

jacket.basis: the node power basis (the X-PAR-02 stamp covers jacket loss + agitator, A-M-289); the jacket geometry is the envelope annulus (layout choice, WORK_ORDER W12)

internals.source: the node power basis (jacket loss + agitator, A-M-289)
internals.basis: shaft and two-blade impeller drawn as solids into the purchased drive envelope (plan rule 6); node internals row none, so the tracker records no internal solid

a_ves.basis: reported for the record: the duty claims no holdup figure (the flows are the AQS-RATE-FP-MET design case); no residence time is derived (A-VES)

material.basis: duty section 3 (the node design row matches): Hastelloy C-276 wetted, PTFE gasketed; density 8900 kg/m3 published midpoint for mass reporting; the AQS-STD-001 rule has no C-276 row - no corrosion-allowance value is claimed (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

a_mach_named.purchased: agitator drive (the node power basis names the agitator share of the 0.0449 kW stamp) drawn as its envelope and interface, plan rule 6; the rating reads the maker sheet at order
